hero.headline: Arabic pays a tokenizer tax.
hero.sub: The same bilingual sentence, priced by five tokenizers. The rule beneath each word marks where it was cut: Arabic words are broken into pieces where English words stay whole — how many pieces is the tokenizer's choice, and the ledger below prices it. More tokens is more latency, more cost, and less room in the context window.
hero.canvasAlt: Animated visualization: glyphs of a bilingual sentence regroup into token clusters per tokenizer, showing how English-first tokenizers shatter Arabic words.
fertility.insight: Fertility is the hidden exchange rate: tokens per word sets latency, cost, and how much of a document fits in context.
